```sql
WITH baseline_kids AS (
    SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Gender", "Age", "Location", "Coach"
    FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),

    SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Gender", "Age", "Location", "Coach"
    FROM "sportathon_endline"
)

FROM baseline_kids b

ORDER BY b."Child Name";
```
